description: Fuse two owned entities of the same rarity using the human forge rules. The secondary entity is consumed even on failure; the primary keeps its identity. Common/Rare/Epic cost 3000/8000/25000 FA for 75% success; 1 gold ticket or 5/15/50 silver tickets guarantees success without FA. FA is taken liquid first then locked, and all net cost goes to buyback. Unknown or foreign ids, incompatible rarity and insufficient balance are refused.

ticket.description: Optional human fusion ticket; eligibility and ownership are checked by the server.
